title: Bill N NDE 21539
content: I remember I was looking down at two men in white, two police, and my mother. They were bent over looking down at a boy lying in the street. I could see an ambulance with the back doors open. It seemed as if I was looking down through a kaleidoscope.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I was hit by a car.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes While looking down I could see my lower body and hands and arms. At that time it did not seem out of place to be floating.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was unconscious, but I know that what I saw was real.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: There was no sound at all.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I saw my mother, two police, and two men in white looking down at a boy in the street.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Mother, father, sisters, brothers, and friends.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I was not able to understand at the time what was happening.
